artNote: Original illustrations for 17과 are still to be drawn, so no question carries art yet. None of them needs one to be answerable: the two questions that come off the chapter’s picture pages — the colour forms and the dot pattern — are asked in words, and every other question is about a form rather than about a thing.

questions.q: Which of the chapter’s four forms says that something very nearly happened and then did not?
뻔하다 attaches to which form of the verb in front of it?
"길이 너무 막혀서 비행기를 ___ 뻔했어요." Which fits?
뻔하다 is used in which tense?

choices.C: either present or past, as you like

questions.q: You drove your grandmother home. Which pair does the chapter use?
What does 가져다 주다 become when it is said quickly, as in ordering a pizza?
까맣다 with -(으)ㄴ in front of a noun gives which form?
Which ending leaves the ㅎ of 빨갛다 exactly where it is?
"창문이 ___ 있어요." The window is open. Which fits?
What does 옷을 걸고 있어요 say that 옷이 걸려 있어요 does not?

choices.A: that somebody is doing the hanging right now
choices.B: that the clothes have been there a long time
choices.C: that the clothes are in a wardrobe rather than on a hook
choices.D: nothing — the two mean the same thing

questions.q: The chapter’s 발음 rule: a 받침 ㄴ standing in front of a ㄹ is read how?

choices.D: it is not said at all

questions.q: Which of these is the pattern of scattered round dots?
